q: How much CO2 does pressing coconut oil emit per litre?
title: Coconut oil expeller CO2 per litre
short: Expellers and filters run on electricity: kWh times 0.710 kg CO2, divided by litres of oil. Copra drying before pressing is usually larger and belongs to whoever dries it. Packaging and freight are Scope 3.
audience: Coconut oil mills and brand owners

ul: Litres or kg of oil produced, and cake sold.
Copra purchases with the drier's fuel if you can get it.

p: Cake is a co product. Split emissions between oil and cake by mass or value, and say which.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.
